title: SunIslandArrowAddon
body:
A server-side quiver and custom arrows plugin solution supporting high versions of Minecraft! Compatible with MythicMobs and MMOItems. Requires MythicLib as a dependency.
Tested only on 1.21... Should theoretically support any version that MythicLib 1.7 supports!

Features:

**Custom Arrow System** - Fully supports custom names, lore, and particle effects! You can set the damage multiplier upon hit to be high or low, and even execute MythicMobs skills when the arrow hits.

**Quiver System** - A 9-slot private arrow storage space that automatically retrieves arrows when needed. In addition to common arrows, firework rockets can be loaded for crossbow shooting _(firework rockets are automatically equipped to the off-hand!)_. Even use Shift + number keys to quickly switch between selected arrows!

Have fun!
